notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE! Titanic D-deck and more!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have another large update that we have just uploaded to Steam! This update consists of both additions and changes in seperate sections.

[h1]Additions:    [/h1]

We have just added Titanic's D-deck as another interior option for you to explore! We removed the Turkish Bath's as the quality compared to all of these other interior options was not the same.

notes.title: Christmas Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just released a small update for Titanic: The Experience! People asked for a daytime mode where you can explore the Titanic, so we added it (we also removed the locked camera mode as the free roam camera roam option was preferred)! We also changed the menu title to reflect the name update from last time. Merry Christmas and happy holidays!

If you have any other recommendations, let us know!

We also have our next simulation releasing in January 2021, if you are interested we will leave the link here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487420/Wilhelm_Gustloffs_Death/

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios.   [/h1]

notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just massively updated Titanic! Interiors, a new night scene and other changes have been added!

[h1]Interiors    [/h1]

We have added Titanic's Marconi room and Turkish baths as seperate levels that you can explore!

notes.title: Large Titanic update! Fixes and more!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have updated Titanic to fix some issues! The changes are described below.

[h1]Additions And Changes:    [/h1]

[list]

[*]The lifeboats now do not go too far away from the Titanic. This is to reduce the chances of the player being flung out of them

[*]Ladders have been added to the stern of the Titanic. You can now explore the stern without being stuck at the back!

[*]We have changed the camera properties, there is now little to no clipping at all!

[*]When the Titanic sinks, the camera will now not wobble

[*]When you die, instead of being returned to the main menu, the level is reloaded (after the death screen)

[*]Player height has been decreased for easier movement

[*]Player jumping has also been decreased

[*]Updated text for the main menu and loading screen

[/list]

If you are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review!


[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]

notes.title: Update Revert
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have had to push Titanic back to an older version (1 version earlier from the most recent update, so the splitting in half update is still in) as many of the audio files were not working, e.g. the iceberg collision, funnels falling or the splitting in half. We hope to get this fixed soon! In the next update, in addition to fixing these issues, we will be adding new smoke effects to the sinking scene, and replacing the old ones.

Please let us now if the audio for the sinking scene was working in the previous update, as it may just be our end that something went wrong.

notes.title: Patch is here and revised system requirements
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

The Titanic patch has arrived.

[h1]Fixed:    [/h1]

-The flare audio should now start very close to when the flares start

-Ladders have been added into the main gamemode and exploration gamemode. These will help you not being stuck at the back of the Titanic. Please note that due to issues with the iceberg collision scene, ladders couldn't be added to that particular level.

[h1]Other:    [/h1]

-The system requirements for Titanic have been updated, the old system specifications were actually too high.

The revised system requirements are:

[b]SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS
MINIMUM:
OS: Windows 7 or higher
Processor: 2.3 GHz i5
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: At least 32mb graphics.
Storage: 1 GB available space

notes.title: Titanic update has arrived! Interiors|New sinking and more!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Today the content update for Titanic has arrived!

[h1]Added:    [/h1]

Interiors for the grand staircase and turkish baths have been added. The turkish baths can be entered at the start of the ship, near the captains bridge. You just walk through the door and you will enter it. The grand staircase is entered through the wooden doors just after the 4th lifeboat from the start of the ship.

We have added a new scene, where you can see the Titanic sink from a lifeboat view.

A much slower sinking animation has been created for the Titanic as requested by the community. This gives the game a much more realistic feeling.

[h1]Changed: [/h1]

We have removed the ship travelling to Ireland as the scene for that was not smooth.

We re-arranged the dock for the first level

We added creaking sounds to the ship as it sank, as requested by the community.

We removed the exploring mode for the Titanic.

The jumping bug should now be 90% fixed.

New sounds added for the walking when the Titanic hits the iceberg level.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Patch 1 Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

The first patch for Titanic has arrived! It should make the game a smoother experience for players.

[h1]Fixes:    [/h1]

-Water on level 2 has been fixed

-The ropes on the Titanic have no collision anymore as they would make the player jump in the air

-Some box colliders have been added on the Titanic to decrease clipping. The camera has also been adjusted to decrease clipping.

The next update may include some new content such as new audio, and a new mode!

Interactive Gaming Studios
